title: Rents rose 4% in 2024, review finds
text:
Rents rose by 4% in 2024, a review published this week found.

The review covered every centre on the island. Rents rose by 4% in 2024, it said, and the increase was spread evenly across the year.

A spokesperson later confirmed that rents rose by 4% in 2024, and said no further change is planned.
